_about: Texture presets for portrait/texture.py. template: a file in textures/templates. paint: which part of the template is the part (opaque, transparent, black, white). mode: fill, stamp or inpaint. prompt: words around yours, {you} marks where yours go. Anything in the script's DEFAULTS (checkpoint, steps, cfg, sampler, scheduler, negative, denoise, feather, close) can be set per preset.

bra.about: VRoid bra top: fabric clipped to the cups and straps
bra.prompt: flat fabric texture, top-down, even lighting, seamless, {you}

panties.about: VRoid panties: fabric clipped to the shape
panties.prompt: flat fabric texture, top-down, even lighting, seamless, {you}

irises.about: VRoid eye irises: one iris, stamped into both circles
irises.prompt: anime eye iris, front view, centered, perfectly circular, flat, no eyelids, no skin, {you}
irises.negative: lowres, worst quality, bad quality, text, watermark, eyelid, eyelashes, skin, face, person, multiple eyes, cropped, frame
